interface.signature: def stringConversion(X: str, Y: str) -> int:

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in X) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in Y)
preconditions.description: Both X and Y consist only of alphabetic characters (case-insensitive).
The lengths of X and Y are between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(Y[i] == X[j].upper() for i in range(len(Y)) for j in range(len(X)) if Y[i] == X[j].upper() or Y[i] == X[j].lower()) and len(Y) <= len(X) else 0
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if and only if Y can be obtained from X by (1) converting some lowercase letters in X to uppercase, and (2) deleting all remaining lowercase letters (including those not converted). The uppercase letters in Y must exactly match a subsequence of the uppercase letters in X (after conversion).
